answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 29632 Country: India Title: Sir please explain With regard to your fatwa answer((Fatwa: 1602/L=454/tl=1431) : (5) It is forbidden to offer nafl salah from the dawn to sunrise and after Asr salah till sunset, but it is not prohibited to offer fardh or qaza salah Please clearify whether it is forbidden to offer salah after fardh namaz of fazr(morning) to sunrise or from dawn to sunrise .can?t we offer salatul tawaf after dawn but before fardh prayer of fazr(mornig) ? Question: Assalmu alaikum Wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuhu Sir please explain With regard to your fatwa answer((Fatwa: 1602/L=454/tl=1431) : (5) It is forbidden to offer nafl salah from the dawn to sunrise and after Asr salah till sunset, but it is not prohibited to offer fardh or qaza salah Please clearify whether it is forbidden to offer salah after fardh namaz of fazr(morning) to sunrise or from dawn to sunrise .can?t we offer salatul tawaf after dawn but before fardh prayer of fazr(mornig) ? Answer ID: 29632 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 211/252/L=1432) Probably you misunderstood it. It is related to Asr salah not to Fajr salah i.e. it is forbidden to offer any other nafl salah from dawn to sunrise other than sunnah of Fajr salah. و منع ... عن النفل بعد طلوع الفجر باكثر من سنته (ملتقى الابحر) Hence, it is not right to offer Salat al-Tawaf after dawn. However, one may offer as many nafl salah as he wishes until one does not offer Asr salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
